content: Atɔŋ, ntɔn ndaa iler ngyeel a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ anà nköŋ abi apà nde, bi kàmàlalɔɔm:

isàkal naa imɛɛy mwɛy kyàngɔɔm, itàkal ndaa a mbuur mwɛy, itàkal ndaa a un'kaan mwɛy bàmɛɛy naa yàfü akà bi, yàmàlakyään naa ilä a Mwol kyà kyàyà itaan, twon lan'düül musà lingyoomà unsà an'kyän abɛ itàkal muman bɔɔmà ntɔn ya.
Wɛy akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akàlabwiy ndwaŋ, itàkal kaben. Ntɔn kusà a ilä aki muyà, baar mbɔɔn bàtwab atàpiy làkwikilà anà aŋufur a nkyɛl awà un'kyàbwà, utwab atàmɛnà,
nde mbuur afàmbarà anà afàmbäär undiir wanswà bàfàbel naa nzam itàkal naa undiir wanswà bàfàsà làkoo. Nde afàkàbwaay tii u ndwà a Nzam anà mukyään nde ŋakwo naa nde wà Nzam.
Nkye bɛ làfàkayɔbà anki naa mɛ kàkyàlakyään ndaa ayin utaaŋ kàkäl mɛ tsütsü apà bɛ?
Apanà, bɛ làkyàyöb undiir akun'taa mpi ntɔn nde uyàmɛnà nà utaaŋ kàyöŋà Nzam ntɔn nde.
Ntɔn ngyee a ube yàkyàsɛmà musal. Yan'sal nà mulwom mbuur akataa wa mpi,
apan mbuur un'be waa usàmɛnà, mbuur usàdwa Mwol Yɛsu u mbwo a un'swey a mun ande, anà asun'buul undiir a bunàbun u mbwo a in'nyääŋ a ngyeel ande.
Mbuur un'be asàyà u ngwal a Satanà, nde asàkyer isal a ngwal byifà ifà, impà, idiim a loor,
anà mbwo yanswà mpa ayà balàbal ntɔn mukur baar bàdiimà mbwo, ntɔn ba bàwɛl anki ukwen a ndandaa abà bàlawiiy mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyakin Nzam katöömà nde ngwal a ndiimà ntɔn ba bàsi làkwikilà u ndaa a loor,
ntɔn baar banswà mpa bàsi làkwikilà amu ndandaa, wɛɛ bàmɛn un'sak ntɔn ndaa mpa ayà balàbal, bàwɛl ntaaŋàmbar.

Atɔŋ, akà bi, bi ikyer afuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam taaŋ lanswà ntɔn bɛ, nkween a Mwol, ntɔn Nzam kàlasɔ̈ɔ̈l fà nsɛmà, ntɔn bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a Dweelà afàkyɛɛl anà u mbwo a làkwikilà amu ndandaa.
Ntɔn ya sye, nde kàlabel u mbwo a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kàlakyään bi, ntɔn bɛ làwɛl kab unsà làkoo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kyakin, atɔŋ, làkäl aŋàtsim anà làkäär an'lɔɔŋ kàlapɛ bi, itàkal u mun, itàkal unsun'kaan.
Wɛy Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ nde ŋakwo, anà Taaràbi Nzam, awà kikwen, anà u mbwo a kab a ngway ande, kipɛ ndɛɛl a mbul a in'tye anà làkyän aŋàbwaŋ,
bàlalɛɛl anà bàlapɛ ngwal amu isal kyanswà anà ndaa aŋàbwaŋ yanswà.
